description:
AGENTS.md notes that jmap-mail-types uses `#[non_exhaustive]` as a pattern for spec-defined enums likely to grow. The pattern should apply to every type-crate's Property enum, since RFCs add property names over time.

Affected (greenfield, no lock):
- jmap-tasks-types: TaskProperty, TaskListProperty, TaskNotificationProperty (3)
- jmap-calendars-types: 3-4 Property enums
- jmap-contacts-types: AddressBookProperty, ContactCardProperty (2)
- jmap-filenode-types: FileNodeProperty (1)
- jmap-sharing-types: PrincipalProperty, ShareNotificationProperty (2)
- BackendSetError in jmap-server (LOCKED — separate finding)

Total: ~12 enums lacking `#[non_exhaustive]` that should have it.

Why P2: missing `#[non_exhaustive]` means adding a new variant in a future RFC update is a SemVer breaking change. For a 0.x crate this is technically allowed, but the workspace's stated convention is that property enums are non_exhaustive.

Fix: add `#[non_exhaustive]` to the affected enum declarations. ~12 lines changed across 5 crates.

Note: clippy 0.74+ has a lint for missing non_exhaustive on public enums (`exhaustive_enums`); could be added to the lint config.
title: P2: 12 greenfield Property enums missing #[non_exhaustive]
